ours.notes: static binary, no runtime to install (Linux: no libc dependency)

tumf.runtime_kind: Python interpreter uvx resolved for the venv
tumf.notes: venv is the per-package environment uvx materializes under its cache; uv cache holds the wheels; the interpreter is uv-managed CPython when no system one matches

g0t4.runtime_kind: Node.js (system package: node binary + bundled npm modules)
g0t4.notes: package env is the npx cache dir for this package; runtime is the system Node.js install
